import json
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
URI = 'file:inputs/observations.sqlite?mode=ro'
RAW = Path('outputs/rows.json')
REPORT = Path('outputs/report.json')

connection = sqlite3.connect(URI, uri=True)
rows = connection.execute('SELECT label, value FROM observations')
values = [{'label': label, 'value': value} for label, value in rows]
connection.close()
RAW.write_text(json.dumps(values), encoding='utf-8')
